title: Test Drive
description: Books a test drive of a new Toyota at a showroom: licence, driver, showroom, nearest free time, read-back, save, one message and the short survey

nodes.title: Start
nodes.detail: Sets safety_flag, person_requested, manager_requested, stand_request, caller_number
nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ start A new activation starts clean: the working fields and the results of earlier tool calls are removed. Values passed in by the supervisor are kept: caller_phone, customer_name, crm_customer_id, identity_status, lead_id, model_of_interest, and the name and number the caller already gave on this call (caller_name, contact_mobile), so that neither is asked for again. A caller who left mid-task and comes back resumes at the step where they stopped, so this step does not run again for them. caller_number is the caller's own number for this task: the number they confirmed or gave earlier on the call, otherwise the number they are calling from. An open lead is looked up by the calling number, because that is the number the lead system knows the caller by, and then by the caller's own number when that is another one (S25, the same two numbers as the sales specialist). S25: the age below which an open lead is reused is the sales specialist's setting, read here once. A missing or unreadable value counts as 30, the interim rule of the use-case document.

nodes.title: Compose lead notes
nodes.detail: Sets lead_synced, model_of_interest, call_summary, lead_notes, booking_notes
nodes.comment: The test drive belongs to a lead. A lead passed in by the supervisor is used; otherwise the caller's open lead is looked up by the calling number and then by their own number, and a lead is created only when none exists or the newest one is too old to reuse (S25). DESIGN S36: the grade, engine or colour goes to the showroom in the lead notes. DESIGN S37: so does the preferred time when no free time suited. The notes also name the model and the showroom, so that a note added to a lead that already existed is complete without the test drive record. The notes are written again every time the flow comes here, so lead_synced starts as false: it turns true only when these notes were saved on the lead. A lead created earlier in the call (for example before a picked time was lost, S40) is therefore updated, never assumed to be up to date. Contract v2: the model the request is for goes back to the supervisor as model_of_interest. create_sales_lead requires a call summary: when the step that should have written one did not, a plain sentence stands in, so that a lead is never refused for that reason.

nodes.title: Find lead
nodes.comment: OPEN S25 (Sales workshop Q5): Should the AI agent add this to the lead from two weeks ago, or create a new lead? Interim, the same rule as the sales specialist with the same setting (lead_reuse_max_age_days, 30 unless TOYOTA_SALES_LEAD_REUSE_MAX_AGE_DAYS says otherwise): the newest open lead is reused while it is younger than that many days, so the same sales executive keeps the customer. An older one is left alone and a new lead is created. The newest open lead is the one the tool names (leads are returned newest first). A new lead needs a positive answer: an open lead that is old enough, or no open lead at all. An answer that is neither (and a setting that cannot be read) never starts a second lead: the open lead is reused, or the lookup counts as failed.

nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ S39 S40 S41 the save OPEN S39 (Sales workshop Q10): Is the booking confirmed on the call, or does the showroom confirm it first? Interim: the showroom confirms first. TOYOTA_TEST_DRIVE_CONFIRM_ON_CALL = false (default) always says the showroom will confirm. With true the caller hears confirmed, but only when the booking tool returns the status confirmed; its other status, pending_showroom_confirmation, is always said as waiting. A refused save names its reason. slot_taken: the time went to someone else (S40). validation, or no reason at all: the booking simply did not save (S41). A call that fails technically is S41 as well.

nodes.comment: OPEN S45 (Sales workshop Q12): How soon should the sales executive call the customer? Interim in the document: within 60 minutes if the showroom is open, first thing the next morning if it is closed, or at the time the customer asked. The promise is computed by the lead tool and only repeated here; when the tool gave none, no time is stated. A time the caller asked for that was added to a lead afterwards replaces a promise the lead tool worked out earlier without it, so the caller hears their own time and not a promise that no longer applies. A sentence worded on an earlier pass is dropped here, so that only the one for this request is said.

nodes.detail: The caller has just been told that the showroom will be in touch. Do not speak to the caller in this step. Write when_line: one short sentence that tells the caller when to expect…
nodes.comment: Order of speech (contract v2, section 2): when a reasoning step speaks and goes on in the same turn, the platform puts what follows first and appends the step's own words after it, so a sentence spoken here would be heard after the offer of the message or of the survey. The sentence is therefore only worded here, in the caller's language, and written to when_line; the fixed step say_when says it, between the fixed outcome line and the next question. The step always ends in the same turn, so the caller is never left waiting; when nothing was written, nothing is said and the call goes on.

nodes.title: Stand request = true and setting demo mode is true?
nodes.comment: ------------------------------------------------------------------ P14 the AI Summit demonstration DESIGN P14 (journey 09): an attendee really wants a test drive. This branch exists only when TOYOTA_DEMO_MODE is "true". The model raises stand_request in whichever step the attendee says it; the offer, the consent, the details and the request to the stand team are flow steps. Order: say it is a demonstration and offer to pass their details to the team at the Toyota stand; ask for consent; only after a clear yes take their own name and their own mobile, and read the number back; then send. Nothing is said to be sent unless the tool says so. A no takes nothing. Outside the demonstration stand_request means nothing: if it is ever set there, the step it left cannot be resumed, so a person takes over (system_failed).
